releaseNotes:
# Hubble 2.2.0

- **New key looks.** Keys are drawn in Noto Sans SemiBold with text that fits the key. Every button has Background, Outline and Bar colours, and a bar can sit along the top or the bottom. A fuller colour picker shows key previews, named colours and the colours already in your workspace.
- **Feedback lights each part of a key.** Each feedback row can light the background, outline or bar, and a lit outline or bar can blink or fade. Modules can declare their own triggers with their own looks per row. Right-click an action column to turn its live feedback colours off.
- **See the whole key while you edit.** The header and a new Live Key column show each button's full key, action cells light part by part, and Button ID can show the key's look.
- **Hold to confirm.** A module can ask for a press to be held. While you hold, the key fills a disc in the module's colour (Companion plugin 0.3.6).
- **Guided setup and a new Setup Guide.** A six-step checklist in HubDash takes you from Companion to a working key, including network Stream Decks, placing buttons and a tour of the Button Matrix. The rewritten Setup Guide covers feedback, Cyanview and the current app.
- **Beta updates.** Turn on **Get beta updates** in the Hubble menu's **Check for Updates…** window to receive betas before they're released. It's off by default. A beta can upgrade your workspace in a way older versions can't open, so export your configuration first.
- **Choose an older version.** The update window lists every stable release back to 2.0.0.
- **Routers start with the Routes sheet.** New installs include the current Ross Ultrix, AJA KUMO, Blackmagic Videohub and Evertz Quartz modules, with multi-route staging for one Take.
- Fixes: fill drags repeat button colours and text size instead of counting them up; Live Key redraws a key whose bar moved to the top; a new action column and arrow keys keep the selected cell clear of the frozen columns; a reload no longer turns an edit queued behind a save into a conflict.
